T he stage is set for the INDIA bloc’s mega rally at Delhi’s Ramlila Maidan on Sunday (November 1, 2026), with opposition leaders and supporters from different states beginning to reach the national capital for a show of strength against alleged electoral irregularities and to demand the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. The bloc carried out a symbolic “public impeachment” of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar, unanimously adopting a motion by a show of hands on Saturday (October 31). They levelled six charges against him, including conspiring with the ruling BJP to steal elections, deleting 13.2 crore voters through the special intensive revision (SIR) of voter lists, and acting at the behest of Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Home Minister Amit Shah. Opposition parties in West Bengal have stepped up the heat on the issue of 16.10 lakh appeals filed against the inclusion of voters following the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) in the State. Leaders of the Mamata All India Trinamool Congress and the Communist Party of India (Marxist) have questioned the lack of clarity over who authorised the filing of the appeals after the SIR concluded in the State. Opposition in West Bengal questions ECI over 16.10 lakh voter-inclusion appeals amid accountability concerns and SIR controversy. Union Minister Hardeep Singh Puri on Saturday said INDIA bloc’s upcoming rally in Delhi is a “serious political mistake” and asked Congress leader Rahul Gandhi to “introspect”. Mr. Puri called the INDIA bloc’s Sunday (November 1) rally as “completely insensitive to the mass atrocities committed 42 years ago”. He noted that the trading community has also urged the Congress to reconsider the date of the rally in view of the festive season. Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) founder Abhijeet Dipke on Saturday (October 31) met Trinamool Congress supremo Mamata Banerjee in Delhi and thanked her for supporting the outfit’s youth-led protests, while extending solidarity with the INDIA bloc rally on the “vote chori” charge. He, however, said that the CJP would retain its independent identity and not join the Sunday protest by the opposition parties. Mr. Dipke said he had called on Ms. Banerjee to express gratitude for her support to the outfit’s first protest at Jantar Mantar on the NEET paper leak issue and her backing when its leaders Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka were arrested by the Delhi Police. Left leaders on Saturday (October 31) accused Chief Election Commissioner (CEC) Gyanesh Kumar of undermining universal adult franchise through the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) exercise, with CPI(M) MP John Brittas alleging that even elected representatives are being made to establish their eligibility to vote. The CEC has lost the moral and legal authority to remain in office, he asserted. Speaking at the INDIA bloc’s “public impeachment” programme, Mr. Brittas said citizens who had exercised their franchise for decades are now finding their names deleted from electoral rolls, being summoned for hearings, and being told to prove their existence. The Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) on Saturday (October 31, 2026) accused the Congress and its allies of ridiculing democratic institutions by staging a mock Parliament session, and said that Opposition parties had repeatedly disrupted proceedings in the real Parliament. At a press conference, BJP MP Sambit Patra referred to the structure resembling the old Parliament building erected for the mock Parliament session and said: “They want to retain everything from the old British-era structure... They should seat Rahul Gandhi ji as the mock Prime Minister in that very old structure. We have absolutely no objection.” BJP ridicules INDIA bloc’s mock Parliament, defends SIR, political double standards, and highlights alleged vote protection amid poverty claims. The chair on which former Lok Sabha Speaker Meira Kumar sat while presiding over the INDIA bloc’s “public impeachment” of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar on Saturday (October 31) was once occupied by the country’s first Prime Minister, Jawaharlal Nehru. The information was provided by Congress’ media and publicity department head Pawan Khera, who was involved with organising the symbolic public impeachment. Today, in that very chair, invoking the spirit of Nehru, former Lok Sabha Speaker Meira Kumar pronounced Gyanesh Kumar unfit to continue as the Chief Election Commissioner of India, Mr. Khera said. The Janata Dal (United) on Saturday (OCtober 31) termed the INDIA bloc’s public impeachment exercise against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar a “drama”, accusing the Congress of trying to push the country towards anarchy. JD(U) national spokesperson Rajeev Ranjan Prasad told PTI that the exercise does not reflect the role of a constructive opposition and that the entire episode reflects an extremist perspective and will not help resolve any dispute. “This is not going to resolve any dispute in any manner. It is an attempt to push the country towards anarchy,” Mr. Prasad told PTI . The Indian National Developmental, Inclusive Alliance’s symbolic “public impeachment” of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar on Saturday (October 31, 2026) featured accounts from voters who alleged that their names had been deleted from electoral rolls during the special intensive revision (SIR) exercise. Among them was Anita Jaiswal, who moved from Kolkata to Delhi. She said she had voted in every election between 2012 and 2025 but was now being asked to establish her citizenship. Voters allege name removals in SIR; activists condemn EC during CEC Gyanesh Kumar impeachment at Kharge residence, New Delhi. Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge on Saturday (October 31) demanded the immediate removal of CEC Gyanesh Kumar and the scrapping of the 2023 law providing immunity to the CEC, accusing the poll panel chief of working under the directions of Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Home Minister Amit Shah. “The Modi government has hatched every conspiracy since 2014 to cling to power: stealing MPs, breaking parties, stealing governments, electoral bonds, misuse of ED/CBI. And now vote theft -- cut opposition votes and rule,” he alleged, adding that there are hundreds of examples of “vote chori”. The Indian National Developmental Inclusive Alliance (INDIA) on Saturday (October 31, 2026) carried out a symbolic “public impeachment” of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar, unanimously adopting a motion by a show of hands. They levelled six charges against him, including conspiring with the ruling BJP to steal elections, deleting 13.2 crore voters through the special intensive revision (SIR) of voter lists, and acting at the behest of Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Home Minister Amit Shah. INDIA bloc stages symbolic public impeachment of CEC Gyanesh Kumar on six charges, claiming electoral manipulation and threats to voters, prompting warnings to officials. The stage is set for the INDIA bloc’s mega rally at Delhi’s Ramlila Maidan on Sunday (November 1), with opposition leaders and supporters from different states beginning to reach the national capital for a show of strength against alleged electoral irregularities and to demand the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. 截取自YouTube的屏幕录像显示，2026年11月1日，新德里拉姆利拉广场正在为印度全国发展赢得包容联盟（INDIA）针对首席选举专员贾内什·库马尔的集会做准备。

印度全国发展赢得包容联盟（INDIA）计划于11月1日星期日在德里的拉姆利拉广场举行大型集会。反对党领导人及来自不同邦的支持者正陆续抵达首都，以展示力量，反对据称存在的选举违规行为，并要求首席选举专员贾内什·库马辞职。

10月31日星期六，该联盟通过举手表决一致通过一项决议，对首席选举专员贾内什·库马举行象征性的“公开弹劾”。联盟提出了六项指控，包括与执政的印度人民党（BJP）串通窃取选举、通过选民名册特别集中修订（SIR）删除1320万名选民，以及听命于总理纳伦德拉·莫迪和内政部长阿米特·沙阿行事。

西孟加拉邦的反对党加大了针对该邦特别集中修订后提交的161万份选民纳入上诉案件的施压力度。印度全国国大党（TMC）和印度共产党（马克思主义）领导人质疑，在该邦完成特别集中修订后，究竟是谁授权提交这些上诉。

西孟加拉邦反对党就161万份选民纳入上诉询问选举委员会，并因问责问题及特别集中修订争议向其施压。

联邦部长哈迪普·辛格·普里星期六表示，INDIA联盟即将在德里举行的集会是“严重的政治错误”，并要求国大党领导人拉胡尔·甘地“反省”。普里称，INDIA联盟原定11月1日星期日举行的集会“对42年前发生的大规模暴行完全漠不关心”。他指出，鉴于节庆季到来，商界也敦促国大党重新考虑集会日期。

蟑螂人民党（CJP）创始人阿布希吉特·迪普克于10月31日星期六在德里会见了国大党（TMC）最高领导人马马塔·班纳吉，感谢她支持该党由青年主导的抗议活动，同时声援INDIA联盟针对“窃取选票”指控举行的集会。不过，他表示，CJP将保持独立身份，不参加反对党于星期日举行的抗议活动。

迪普克称，他曾拜访班纳吉女士，感谢她支持该党于中央广场就全国普通中学教育证书考试（NEET）试题泄露事件举行的首次抗议，并在该党领导人绍拉夫·达斯和阿舒托什·兰卡被德里警方逮捕时为她提供支持。

左翼领导人于10月31日星期六指控首席选举专员贾内什·库马通过特别集中修订活动破坏普选权。印度共产党（马克思主义）议员约翰·布里塔斯称，就连当选代表也被要求证明其投票资格。他断言，首席选举专员已经失去继续任职的道德和法律权威。

布里塔斯在INDIA联盟的“公开弹劾”活动中表示，数十年间一直行使选举权的公民如今发现自己的姓名被从选民名册中删除，还被要求参加聆讯并证明自己仍然存在。

印度人民党（BJP）于10月31日星期六（2026年）指责国大党及其盟友通过仿造议会会议嘲弄民主制度，并称反对党曾多次扰乱真正议会的议事进程。在一次新闻发布会上，BJP议员桑比特·帕特拉提到为仿造议会会议搭建的、仿照旧议会大楼的建筑，并表示：“他们想保留英国统治时期那座旧建筑的一切……他们完全可以让拉胡尔·甘地先生坐上那座老建筑里的模拟总理席位。我们绝对没有异议。”

BJP嘲笑INDIA联盟的模拟议会，为特别集中修订辩护，批评其政治双重标准，并强调有人声称在有关贫困的争议中保护选票。

前人民院议长梅拉·库马尔于10月31日星期六主持INDIA联盟对首席选举专员贾内什·库马尔的“公开弹劾”时所坐的椅子，曾由该国首任总理贾瓦哈拉尔·尼赫鲁坐过。参与组织这场象征性公开弹劾活动的国大党媒体与宣传部门负责人帕万·凯拉提供了相关信息。凯拉说，梅拉·库马尔当天坐在那把椅子上，以尼赫鲁的精神宣布贾内什·库马不再适合担任印度首席选举专员。

人民党（联合）于10月31日星期六称INDIA联盟针对首席选举专员贾内什·库马举行的公开弹劾活动是一场“闹剧”，并指责国大党试图把国家推向无政府状态。JD(U)全国发言人拉杰夫·兰詹·普拉萨德告诉印度斯坦新闻通讯社（PTI），这项活动并未体现建设性反对派应有的作用，整个事件反映出极端主义思维，无助于解决任何争端。

普拉萨德对PTI表示：“这无论如何都无法解决任何争端。这是在试图把国家推向无政府状态。”

印度全国发展赢得包容联盟于10月31日星期六（2026年）对首席选举专员贾内什·库马举行象征性的“公开弹劾”，通过举手表决一致通过一项决议。联盟提出了六项指控，包括与执政的印度人民党（BJP）串通窃取选举、通过选民名册特别集中修订（SIR）删除1320万名选民，以及听命于总理纳伦德拉·莫迪和内政部长阿米特·沙阿行事。

INDIA联盟就六项指控对首席选举专员贾内什·库马举行象征性公开弹劾，称其操纵选举并威胁选民，引发对有关官员的警告。

11月1日星期日，INDIA联盟计划在德里的拉姆利拉广场举行大型集会。反对党领导人及来自不同邦的支持者正陆续抵达首都，以展示力量，反对据称存在的选举违规行为，并要求首席选举专员贾内什·库马辞职。

此次动员并不限于联盟内的政治组成部分。

https://leadership.ng/2027-apm-calls-tin.summary: The party alleged that the Tinubu administration was introducing various financial incentives and relief programmes to influence voters and discourage Nigerians from voting against the ruling government in the forthcoming elections. The National Publicity Secretary of the APM, Abubakar Yusuf, accused the Federal Government of using cash relief announcements to cover up questions surrounding previous government grants and social intervention programmes.
https://leadership.ng/2027-apm-calls-tin.summary_zh: 该党声称，蒂努布政府正推出各种财政激励和纾困计划，以影响选民，并劝阻尼日利亚人在即将举行的选举中反对执政政府。人民进步运动（APM）全国宣传秘书阿布巴卡·优素福指责联邦政府利用现金纾困公告掩盖此前政府补助和社会干预计划所涉的相关问题。
https://leadership.ng/2027-apm-calls-tin.body: The party alleged that the Tinubu administration was introducing various financial incentives and relief programmes to influence voters and discourage Nigerians from voting against the ruling government in the forthcoming elections. The National Publicity Secretary of the APM, Abubakar Yusuf, accused the Federal Government of using cash relief announcements to cover up questions surrounding previous government grants and social intervention programmes. Yusuf, in an exclusive interview with LEADERSHIP, recalled the administration’s earlier claims of empowering vulnerable Nigerians through grants, arguing that the latest N50,000 initiative raised questions about the implementation and accountability of previous interventions. He also referenced the proposed N70,000 transportation allowance for workers, which he claimed had been rejected by workers, describing the various relief announcements as attempts to win public support ahead of the elections. According to him, Nigerians are already determined to vote the Tinubu administration out of power and elect the APM’s proposed candidate, Engr. Seyi Makinde, whom he said had demonstrated achievements during his administration in Oyo State. The APM spokesperson also questioned the government’s decision to introduce another cash relief programme despite unresolved concerns surrounding the N-Power scheme and outstanding allowances allegedly owed to beneficiaries. He specifically accused the government of failing to pay six months of outstanding allowances to N-Power beneficiaries, while also recalling controversies surrounding the Ministry of Humanitarian Affairs that preceded the removal of its former minister. Yusuf described the situation as ironic, questioning why the administration was announcing another financial support programme when previous social intervention commitments had allegedly not been fully addressed. He further expressed concern over Nigerians enrolling for the N50,000 grant, particularly given what he described as the government’s previous claims that similar grants had already been distributed. The APM spokesperson, however, advised Nigerians not to reject the proposed financial assistance but to remain conscious of their voting rights and make independent decisions at the ballot. “My advice, let them collect the money and vote wisely,” he said. Yusuf alleged that the cash relief initiative was an attempt by the ruling government to retain power while leaving the underlying economic challenges facing Nigerians unresolved. He maintained that the country needed sustainable economic policies capable of reducing poverty and improving living conditions rather than temporary financial incentives introduced ahead of elections. The APM insisted that Nigerians should assess political parties and candidates based on their records, policies and capacity to address the country’s economic challenges as the 2027 general elections approach. https://leadership.ng/2027-apm-calls-tin.body_zh: 该党指称，蒂努布政府正在推出各种财政激励和救助计划，以影响选民，并阻止尼日利亚人在即将举行的选举中投票反对执政政府。APM全国宣传秘书阿布巴卡尔·优素福指控联邦政府利用现金救助公告，掩盖围绕历届政府补助金和社会干预计划的种种疑问。优素福在接受《LEADERSHIP》独家采访时回顾了本届政府此前关于通过补助金帮助尼日利亚弱势群体的说法，并认为最新的50,000奈拉计划引发了人们对先前干预措施执行情况和问责机制的疑问。他还提到拟向工作人员提供70,000奈拉交通津贴，称该提案遭到工作人员拒绝，并将各项救助公告描述为在选举前争取公众支持的 attempts。据他所说，尼日利亚人已经下定决心要在选举中把蒂努布政府选下台，并选出APM提名的候选人工程师塞伊·马金德；他称马金德在奥约州执政期间取得了成就。APM发言人还质疑政府为何在N-Power计划相关问题尚未解决、据称仍拖欠受益人津贴的情况下，再推出另一项现金救助计划。他特别指责政府未向N-Power受益人支付六个月的欠发津贴，同时回顾了人道主义事务部围绕其前部长被免职所引发的争议。优素福称这一局面颇具讽刺意味，并质问为何在此前社会干预承诺据称尚未完全落实的情况下，本届政府又要宣布一项新的财政支持计划。他还担忧尼日利亚人报名领取50,000奈拉补助金，尤其考虑到政府此前曾宣称类似补助金已经发放。尽管如此，APM发言人仍建议尼日利亚人不应拒绝拟提供的财政援助，而应牢记自己的投票权，并在投票时独立作出决定。他说：“我的建议是，让他们领取这笔钱，同时明智地投票。”优素福指称，现金救助计划是执政政府为继续掌权而采取的手段，同时却未解决尼日利亚人面临的经济挑战。他坚持认为，国家需要可持续的经济政策，以减少贫困、改善生活条件，而不是在选举前推出临时性财政激励。APM坚持表示，随着2027年大选临近，尼日利亚人应根据各政党和候选人的政绩、政策以及应对国家经济挑战的能力对其进行评估。我们掌握最新动态。获取实时报道、独家爆料和独家视角，直接发送到您的手机。不要满足于过时新闻。加入LEADERSHIP NEWS的WhatsApp频道，随时随地获取24/7更新 →

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary: Contract provides momentum for MASGA initiative Hanwha Group has won its first contract to build a warship for the United States Navy after its acquisition of Philadelphia-based Philly Shipyard in December 2024, marking a tangible step forward in the Korea-U.S. shipbuilding cooperation initiative known as Make American Shipbuilding Great Again (MASGA).
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary_zh: 合同为MASGA倡议注入动力 韩华集团继2024年12月收购总部位于费城的费城船厂后，首次获得为美国海军建造军舰的合同，标志着韩美造船合作倡议“让美国造船再次伟大”（MASGA）取得切实进展。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body: Contract provides momentum for MASGA initiative Hanwha Group has won its first contract to build a warship for the United States Navy after its acquisition of Philadelphia-based Philly Shipyard in December 2024, marking a tangible step forward in the Korea-U.S. shipbuilding cooperation initiative known as Make American Shipbuilding Great Again (MASGA). Hanwha Group said Sunday that Hanwha Defense USA has signed a $269 million (357.5 billion won) contract with TOTE Services to build a landing ship medium (LSM). TOTE Services is a vessel construction manager entrusted by the U.S. Navy with overseeing shipbuilding contracts and managing vessel construction. The construction of the LSM is expected to begin in the fourth quarter of next year, and the contract also includes options for three additional vessels. The LSM is an expeditionary landing vessel designed to support the U.S. Navy's operations in contested coastal areas, including the Indo-Pacific region. It is tasked with transporting and deploying Marine Corps personnel, equipment and supplies to coastal areas. The U.S. Navy aims to secure 35 LSMs. The vessel measures 100 meters in length and 16 meters in width, with a light displacement of approximately 2,687 tons and a cruising range of about 7,400 kilometers. The U.S. Navy’s LSM program is based on the LST-100 design developed by Dutch shipbuilder Damen. The Navy plans to accelerate the initial deployment of the vessels by using an existing commercial design and building them simultaneously at multiple shipyards. TOTE Services selected the shipbuilders through a competitive bidding process, evaluating their safety records, quality standards and track records for on-time delivery. Hanwha Philly Shipyard has maintained a longstanding partnership with TOTE Services, building and delivering four National Security Multi-Mission Vessels under the vessel construction manager model for the U.S. Maritime Administration. Hanwha Defense USA has also deployed personnel to Philadelphia since early this year to support the shipyard's preparations for U.S. Navy projects. Hanwha Group said the order bears significance as it demonstrates Hanwha Philly Shipyard's capabilities to build not only commercial vessels but also naval ships, laying a strategic foundation for expanding its business with the U.S. Navy. Hanwha Group acquired Philly Shipyard for $100 million in 2024 and announced plans in 2025 to invest $5 billion in upgrading the shipyard's infrastructure. In March, Hanwha Philly Shipyard and Hanwha Defense USA participated in the conceptual design of the U.S. Navy's Next Generation Logistics Ship. In July, the shipyard was also selected to build a Missile Range Instrumentation Vessel for the U.S. Golden Dome missile defense system. In September, Hanwha also established a new subsidiary, Hanwha Defense USA Shipbuilding, to operate Hanwha Philly Shipyard and strengthen the group’s shipbuilding and naval defense businesses in the U.S. With the latest order, Hanwha has expanded its involvement in U.S. Navy projects from ship design to construction. "Since acquiring Philly Shipyard in 2024, Hanwha has made substantial investments in personnel and technology to establish a shipbuilding base capable of serving federal government customers, including the U.S. Navy," Hanwha Defense USA CEO Michael Coulter said. "We will continue working with TOTE Services to ensure the vessel is delivered on schedule and within budget." The contract also carries significance as it marks a tangible achievement in warship construction just 15 months after Seoul proposed the MASGA initiative. Under the initiative, Korea agreed to commit $150 billion to bilateral shipbuilding cooperation to help rebuild the U.S. shipbuilding industry and strengthen its naval shipbuilding capabilities. Last year, the U.S. announced plans to procure 364 new vessels by 2054, comprising 293 combat ships and 71 logistics and support vessels, as it seeks to strengthen its naval capability amid intensifying competition with China. Against this backdrop, industry officials said the latest contract served as a stepping stone to provide further momentum for future projects with Korean shipbuilders. U.S. Senator Dave McCormick highlighted Hanwha's planned $5 billion investment in Philadelphia as an example of how cooperation with close U.S. allies can help rebuild America's shipbuilding capacity and strengthen its defense industrial base. “Pennsylvania is leading the way as we rebuild American shipbuilding, bringing jobs, manufacturing and opportunity back to our state,” McCormick said. “Hanwha’s continued commitment to Philadelphia shows what is possible when we invest in American workers and American industry.”
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.title_zh: 韩华获得美国海军首个造船订单
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body_zh: 合同为MASGA倡议注入动力：韩华集团继2024年12月收购总部位于费城的Philly Shipyard后，首次获得美国海军舰船建造合同，标志着韩美造船合作倡议“让美国造船业再次伟大”（MASGA）取得实质性进展。韩华集团周日表示，旗下韩华防务美国公司与TOTE Services签署了一份价值2.69亿美元（3575亿韩元）的合同，将建造一艘中型登陆舰（LSM）。TOTE Services是美国海军委托的船舶建造管理公司，负责监督造船合同并管理舰船建造。该登陆舰预计于明年第四季度开工，合同还包含增建3艘舰船的选择权。LSM是一种远征登陆舰，旨在支持美国海军在争议沿海地区，包括印太地区的行动，负责将海军陆战队人员、装备和物资运送并部署至沿海地区。美国海军计划部署35艘LSM。该舰长100米、宽16米，轻载排水量约2687吨，巡航里程约7400公里。美国海军的LSM项目以荷兰造船商Damen开发的LST-100设计为基础。海军计划利用现有商业设计加速舰船的初始部署，并在多家船厂同时建造。TOTE Services通过竞争性招标程序选择造船商，评估其安全记录、质量标准以及按期交付的业绩。韩华Philly Shipyard与TOTE Services保持着长期合作关系，按照船舶建造管理模式，为美国海事管理局建造并交付了4艘国家安全多任务舰。韩华防务美国公司今年早些时候还向费城派驻人员，支持船厂为美国海军项目做准备。韩华集团表示，这份订单具有重要意义，因为它证明韩华Philly Shipyard不仅能够建造商用舰船，也具备建造军用舰船的能力，为扩大与美国海军的业务往来奠定了战略基础。韩华集团于2024年以1亿美元收购Philly Shipyard，并于2025年宣布计划投资50亿美元升级船厂基础设施。今年3月，韩华Philly Shipyard和韩华防务美国公司参与了美国海军“下一代后勤舰”的概念设计。7月，该船厂还入选为美国“金穹”导弹防御系统建造导弹靶场测量舰。9月，韩华还成立了新子公司韩华防务美国造船公司，负责运营韩华Philly Shipyard，并强化该集团在美国的造船和海防业务。随着最新订单的落地，韩华已将对美国海军项目的参与范围从舰船设计扩大至建造。韩华防务美国公司首席执行官Michael Coulter表示：“自2024年收购Philly Shipyard以来，韩华在人员和技术方面投入了大量资源，建立了能够服务包括美国海军在内的联邦政府客户的造船基地。我们将继续与TOTE Services合作，确保舰船按期并在预算范围内交付。”这份合同还具有重要意义，因为就在首尔提出MASGA倡议仅15个月后，舰船建造便取得了实质性成果。根据该倡议，韩国同意承诺投入1500亿美元开展双边造船合作，以帮助重建美国造船业并增强其军用舰船建造能力。去年，美国宣布计划到2054年前采购364艘新舰船，其中包括293艘作战舰和71艘后勤及支援舰，以应对与中国日益加剧的竞争并增强海军能力。在这一背景下，业内人士表示，最新合同为韩国造船商承接未来项目进一步注入动力提供了垫脚石。美国参议员Dave McCormick强调，韩华计划在费城投资50亿美元，证明了与美国这一密切盟友合作有助于重建美国造船能力、强化国防工业基础。McCormick说：“在我们重建美国造船业的过程中，宾夕法尼亚州正发挥带头作用，把就业、制造业和机遇带回本州。韩华对费城的持续投入表明，对美国工人和美国工业进行投资能够带来何种可能。”

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.summary: South Korea's exports jumped 93.7 percent to a record $115.3 billion in October from a year earlier, driven largely by a sharp increase in semiconductor shipments, data showed Sunday. Strong global demand for semiconductors, coupled with continued investments by major technology companies in artificial intelligence (AI) infrastructure, boosted overall exports, the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Resources said in a press release.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.summary_zh: 数据显示，韩国10月出口额同比增长93.7%，创1153亿美元的历史纪录，主要得益于半导体出货量大幅增加。韩国贸易、工业和资源部在一份新闻稿中表示，全球对半导体的强劲需求，以及主要科技公司持续投资人工智能基础设施，推动了整体出口增长。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.body: South Korea's exports jumped 93.7 percent to a record $115.3 billion in October from a year earlier, driven largely by a sharp increase in semiconductor shipments, data showed Sunday. Strong global demand for semiconductors, coupled with continued investments by major technology companies in artificial intelligence (AI) infrastructure, boosted overall exports, the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Resources said in a press release. Imports rose 36 percent from a year earlier to $72.78 billion, resulting in a trade surplus of $42.5 billion. Cumulative exports for the January-October period exceeded $900 billion for the first time, with the ministry projecting that the country's annual exports could reach $1 trillion as early as November if the current trend continues. By sector, semiconductor exports, a key pillar of Asia's fourth-largest economy, skyrocketed 259 percent from a year earlier to $56.4 billion in October, the release said. Exports of petroleum products jumped 80 percent to $6.92 billion, while those of petrochemical products rose 27.5 percent to $4 billion. Cosmetics exports shot up 57.5 percent to $1.44 billion on rising demand in China, the United States and the European Union. Automobile exports gained 18.1 percent to $6.55 billion, driven by increased overseas demand for gasoline hybrid models. By destination, exports to China soared 133.6 percent to $26.98 billion, driven by strong shipments of semiconductors and wireless communications equipment. Exports to China topped $20 billion for the fifth consecutive month. Shipments to the United States surged 185.8 percent to $24.9 billion, supported by robust demand for semiconductors, computers and electrical equipment used in AI infrastructure. The monthly report also showed exports to Southeast Asian countries rose 128 percent to $21.33 billion, while those to the European Union increased 56.4 percent to $8.1 billion, with both gains driven by strong shipments of chips and automobiles. "The global trade environment remains uncertain, with many small and medium-sized enterprises facing difficulties amid rising protectionism in major economies, shifts in global supply chains and geopolitical tensions in the Middle East," Industry Minister Kim Jung-kwan said. To address these challenges, the government will step up trade cooperation with major export partners and work to remove barriers to exports to ease the burden on businesses, he said
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.title_zh: 芯片销售强劲，韩国10月出口额达到1153亿美元
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.body_zh: 韩国10月出口额同比增长93.7%，创纪录的1153亿美元，主要得益于半导体出货量大幅增加。数据显示，韩国工业贸易资源部在一份新闻稿中表示，全球对半导体的旺盛需求，加上主要科技公司持续投资人工智能基础设施，推动了整体出口增长。进口额同比增长36%，达到727.8亿美元，实现贸易顺差425亿美元。1月至10月累计出口额首次突破900亿美元；该部预计，如果当前趋势持续，韩国全年出口额最早可于11月达到1万亿美元。新闻稿称，作为亚洲第四大经济体的支柱行业，半导体出口额10月同比飙升259%，达到564亿美元。石油产品出口额增长80%，达到69.2亿美元；石化产品出口额增长27.5%，达到40亿美元。受中国、美国和欧盟需求上升推动，化妆品出口额猛增57.5%，达到14.4亿美元。混合动力汽车海外需求增加，推动汽车出口额增长18.1%，达到65.5亿美元。按目的地划分，受半导体和无线通信设备出货量强劲推动，对华出口额飙升133.6%，达到269.8亿美元，对华出口额连续第5个月超过200亿美元。得益于半导体、计算机以及人工智能基础设施所用电气设备的旺盛需求，对美出货额激增185.8%，达到249亿美元。月报还显示，对东南亚国家出口额增长128%，达到213.3亿美元；对欧盟出口额增长56.4%，达到81亿美元，两项增长均得益于芯片和汽车出货量强劲。产业部长金正官表示：“全球贸易环境仍不确定，主要经济体保护主义抬头、全球供应链调整以及中东地缘政治紧张，使许多中小企业面临困难。”他说，为应对这些挑战，政府将加强与主要出口伙伴的贸易合作，并努力消除出口壁垒，以减轻企业负担。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.title: Trump open to talks with N. Korean leader but no meeting scheduled: Rubio
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.summary: WASHINGTON — U.S. President Donald Trump remains open to talks with North Korean leader Kim Jong-un if Pyongyang is willing to discuss issues of concern to Washington and its allies, but no meeting has been scheduled, U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio said Saturday. The comments also followed trilateral talks among Rubio and his South Korean and Japanese counterparts in Atlanta on Friday, during which the three top diplomats reaffirmed their commitment to the complete denuclearization of North Korea.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.summary_zh: 华盛顿——美国总统唐纳德·特朗普表示，只要平壤愿意讨论华盛顿及其盟友关切的问题，他仍愿与朝鲜领导人金正恩会谈，但目前尚未安排会面。美国国务卿马可·鲁比奥星期六说。上述表态是在鲁比奥与韩国、日本外长星期五于亚特兰大举行三方会谈后作出的。三位高级外交官在会谈中重申了实现朝鲜完全无核化的承诺。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body: WASHINGTON — U.S. President Donald Trump remains open to talks with North Korean leader Kim Jong-un if Pyongyang is willing to discuss issues of concern to Washington and its allies, but no meeting has been scheduled, U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio said Saturday. Rubio made the remarks during a press conference following a Group of 20 (G20) foreign ministers' meeting in Atlanta. "I think the president's perspective is, if North Korea and Kim Jong-un is prepared to talk with the United States about issues that are of concern to us and of concern to our allies, like South Korea, he would be open to doing it," Rubio said. "Nothing has been scheduled. I do not have anything to announce in regards to that today," he added. His remarks came amid persistent speculations over the possibility of renewed diplomacy between Trump and Kim, who held three meetings during Trump's first presidential term. The comments also followed trilateral talks among Rubio and his South Korean and Japanese counterparts in Atlanta on Friday, during which the three top diplomats reaffirmed their commitment to the complete denuclearization of North Korea. "The president doesn't view talks, doesn't view meeting with someone as a concession." Rubio said. "I know in traditional foreign policy, meeting with someone or inviting someone to something is viewed as a concession that somehow legitimizes them." Asked of recent U.S. visa refusal or delay cases involving South Korean legislators, Rubio said the two countries will "work through" the issue on a bilateral basis. "I think there was one particular visa individual, that there was an issue about regarding behavior, perhaps a couple decades ago. But we'll work through that at a bilateral basis," the secretary said. Rep. Jin Sung-joon of South Korea's ruling Democratic Party (DP) said he has been issued a U.S. visa for a trip to the U.S. Pacific Command, days after he said his application was rejected. Jin's initial visa rejection followed a similar case involving Rep. Jung Chung-rae, former chairman of the DP, earlier this month
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.title_zh: 鲁比奥：特朗普愿与朝鲜领导人会谈，但尚未安排会晤
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body_zh: 华盛顿——美国国务卿马可·鲁比奥周六表示，如果朝鲜愿意讨论令华盛顿及其盟友关切的问题，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普仍愿与朝鲜领导人金正恩会谈，但目前尚未安排会面。鲁比奥是在亚特兰大举行的二十国集团外长会议结束后的新闻发布会上作出上述表态的。鲁比奥说：“我认为总统的态度是，如果朝鲜和金正恩准备就令我们以及韩国等盟友关切的问题与美国对话，他愿意进行会谈。目前没有任何安排。我今天在这方面没有什么可宣布的。”此前，外界一直猜测特朗普与金正恩可能重启外交接触。金正恩曾在特朗普首个总统任期内与他举行三次会面。这些表态此前还出现在鲁比奥与其韩国和日本 counterparts 周五于亚特兰大举行的三方会谈之后，三名最高外交官在会谈中重申了对朝鲜完全无核化的承诺。鲁比奥说：“总统不认为进行会谈或与某人见面是一种让步。我知道，在传统外交政策中，与某人见面或邀请某人参加某种活动，会被视为一种让步，仿佛这样就能赋予他们合法性。”当被问及美国近期拒绝或延迟向韩国议员发放签证的案件时，鲁比奥表示，两国将在双边基础上“妥善处理”这个问题。这名国务卿说：“我记得有一名特定的签证申请人，可能因行为方面的问题遭到拒签，那或许是几十年前的事了。但我们会在双边基础上妥善处理。”韩国执政党民主党议员 진成俊表示，他已获发赴美国太平洋司令部的美国签证；就在几天前，他曾称自己的签证申请遭到拒发。진成俊最初遭拒签之前，本月早些时候，该党前主席郑忠莱也遭遇了类似情况

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.title: Korea's top diplomat discusses ties with German, Polish counterparts
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.summary: Foreign Minister Cho Hyun met separately with his German and Polish counterparts on the sidelines of a Group of 20 (G20) meeting in Atlanta to discuss ways to enhance bilateral cooperation, his office said Saturday. Cho met with German Foreign Minister Johann Wadephul on Friday (U.S. time), expressing hope for deeper ties with the European nation in a wide range of areas, including defense, the economy and cutting-edge industries, according to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.summary_zh: 韩国外交部长赵显（Cho Hyun）在亚特兰大举行的二十国集团（G20）会议期间，分别会见德国和波兰外长，讨论加强双边合作的方法。外交部周六表示，赵显周五（美国时间）会见德国外长约翰·瓦德富尔（Johann Wadephul），并表示希望与这个欧洲国家在国防、经济和前沿产业等广泛领域建立更紧密的关系。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body: Foreign Minister Cho Hyun met separately with his German and Polish counterparts on the sidelines of a Group of 20 (G20) meeting in Atlanta to discuss ways to enhance bilateral cooperation, his office said Saturday. Cho met with German Foreign Minister Johann Wadephul on Friday (U.S. time), expressing hope for deeper ties with the European nation in a wide range of areas, including defense, the economy and cutting-edge industries, according to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs. In response, Wadephul thanked Seoul's foreign ministry for successfully preparing for German Chancellor Friedrich Merz's recent visit to Korea and expressed hope for expanded cooperation in bilateral trade and investment. Cho also met with his Polish counterpart, Radoslaw Sikorski, and called for continued discussions on cooperation in areas such as defense and batteries as a follow-up to Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk's visit to Korea in April, the ministry said. Sikorski also requested Korea's attention and support for Warsaw's efforts to join the G20, with Cho proposing continued consultations on the matter
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.title_zh: 韩国外交部长与德国、波兰外长讨论双边关系

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/photos/2026.body: PHOTOS Halloween returns to Itaewon Listen Listen Text Size Print Summary Close summary Itaewon, Seoul, saw Halloween crowds return on Saturday, with the main road closed to traffic and tens of thousands of pedestrians celebrating. The neighborhood had spent the years after the 2022 crowd crush under cautious commemoration and heavy police presence. More people wore costumes, and parents with young children visited early. Line 6 trains began skipping Itaewon Station at 11:47 p.m., followed by an emergency alert about overcrowding on World Culture Food Street at 11:50 p.m. How many years does it take a neighborhood to recover from tragedy? Four years ago, central Seoul's multicultural Itaewon neighborhood suffered an unspeakable accident, when over 150 people were crushed to death in a crowded alley. In the two years following the disaster, there was an atmosphere of cautious commemoration under the watchful eye of a heavy police presence, as people worked through their trauma — and also feared judgment for being too celebratory. The area may never be the same again, but Halloween 2026 seemed a step closer back to business as usual. Halloween decorations were popping up through the neighborhood over the past few weeks, and hardcore Christians were out protesting the holiday and its perceived queerness. But it was not until Friday that the crowds really started showing up. On Saturday, the main road through Itaewon was closed off to road traffic — a precautioun that should have been taken four years ago — handing the street over to tens of thousands of pedestrians celebrating the holiday. Making room in the streets helped significantly to reduce the pressure on the local alleys. People in costumes were out in larger numbers than the last couple years. There were people in silly costumes, scary costumes, gory costumes, many which would have been considered inappropriate in the previous two years. Notably, parents with young children were out in the area early on. According to Yonhap, more than 32,000 people had gathered in Itaewon as of 10 p.m., but the crowd grew larger more after that. At 11:47 p.m., Line 6 subway trains began skipping Itaewon Station. At 11:50 p.m., an emergency text message was sent out notifying people to avoid Itaewon's World Culture Food Street due to overcrowding. The wounds of Halloween 2022 will never fully heal, but the community has shown that it is finally ready to keep on living
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/photos/2026.body_zh: 图片 听听 文字大小 打印 摘要 关闭摘要 星期六，首尔梨泰院再次迎来万圣节人群，主要道路封闭禁止车辆通行，数万名行人走上街头庆祝。自2022年发生踩踏事故以来，这个街区一直保持谨慎纪念，并部署大量警力。今年更多人穿上了 costumes，家长也带着年幼的孩子早早前来。6号线列车于晚上11时47分开始跳过梨泰院站，随后在晚上11时50分发布紧急警报，警告世界文化美食街出现人员拥挤。一个街区需要多少年才能从悲剧中走出来？四年前，首尔市中心多元文化街区梨泰院发生了一场难以言喻的事故，超过150人在拥挤的小巷中被踩踏致死。灾难后的两年里，在大量警力的注视下，街区弥漫着谨慎纪念的气氛，人们努力消化创伤，也担心因庆祝过度而受到指责。这个地区或许再也无法回到从前，但2026年的万圣节似乎朝着恢复日常更近了一步。过去几周，万圣节装饰逐渐出现在街区各处，保守派基督徒也外出抗议这个节日及其被认为带有怪异气质的特点。直到星期五，人群才真正开始涌现。星期六，穿过梨泰院的主要道路被封闭，禁止车辆通行——这是四年前本应采取的一项预防措施——街道被交给数万名庆祝这一节日的行人。腾出街道空间有助于大幅缓解周边小巷的压力。身穿戏服的人数比过去几年明显更多。其中有滑稽戏服、恐怖戏服和血腥戏服，而其中许多在过去两年会被认为不合适。值得注意的是，带着年幼孩子的家长很早就来到了这一地区。据韩联社报道，截至晚上10时，已有超过32000人聚集在梨泰院，但此后人群规模进一步扩大。晚上11时47分，6号线地铁列车开始跳过梨泰院站。晚上11时50分，系统发出紧急短信，通知人们因人员拥挤而避开梨泰院世界文化美食街。2022年万圣节留下的伤疤永远不会完全愈合，但这个社区已经表明，它终于准备好继续生活下去……

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.summary: Foreign Minister Cho Hyun has explained Seoul's position on a recent land mine blast in the Demilitarized Zone (DMZ) at a Group of 20 (G20) meeting and highlighted the need for inter-Korean dialogue, his office said Sunday. South Korea has blamed the North for the Sept. 21 mine blast inside the DMZ separating the two Koreas that injured three South Korean soldiers, and has called for military talks to ease tensions.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.summary_zh: 韓國外交通商部大臣趙顯在二十國集團（G20）會議上說明了首爾對最近發生於非軍區（DMZ）的地雷爆炸事件的立場，並強調有必要展開南北韓對話。他的辦公室週日表示，韓國已將9月21日發生在分隔南北韓的非軍區內、造成3名韓國士兵受傷的地雷爆炸事件歸咎於朝鮮，並呼籲舉行軍事會談以緩和緊張局勢。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body: Foreign Minister Cho Hyun has explained Seoul's position on a recent land mine blast in the Demilitarized Zone (DMZ) at a Group of 20 (G20) meeting and highlighted the need for inter-Korean dialogue, his office said Sunday. South Korea has blamed the North for the Sept. 21 mine blast inside the DMZ separating the two Koreas that injured three South Korean soldiers, and has called for military talks to ease tensions. Pyongyang, however, has denied responsibility, vowing to take military action along the border if needed. During the two-day G20 foreign ministers' meeting in Atlanta, Cho explained Seoul's stance on the explosion, noting that communication between the two Koreas is more important than ever to ease tensions, according to the ministry. He also noted that deepening military cooperation between Pyongyang and Moscow has serious implications for security on the Korean Peninsula and in the region, it said, as the two sides have forged closer ties through the deployment of North Korean troops to support Russia's war against Ukraine. Cho asked for support from G20 members for Seoul's efforts to promote peaceful coexistence and reduce tensions on the Korean Peninsula. He also highlighted the need for international cooperation to ensure freedom of navigation through the Strait of Hormuz, adding that Seoul will continue to make substantive contributions to ensure safe passage in the strategic waterway

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body_zh: 韩国外交部长赵显在二十国集团（G20）会议上说明了首尔对最近发生在非军事区（DMZ）的地雷爆炸事件的立场，并强调需要恢复朝韩对话。他的办公室周日表示，韩国指责朝鲜制造了9月21日发生在这两个朝鲜半岛分隔线内的地雷爆炸事故，造成3名韩国士兵受伤，并呼吁举行军事会谈以缓和紧张局势。然而，平壤否认对此负责，并发誓必要时将采取军事行动。在为期两天的二十国外交部长会议期间，赵显在亚特兰大说明了首尔对爆炸事件的立场。外交部称，他指出，为缓和紧张局势，朝韩之间的沟通比以往任何时候都更加重要。他还说，平壤与莫斯科深化军事合作对朝鲜半岛及该地区的安全产生了严重影响。自朝鲜部署军队支持俄罗斯对乌克兰的战争以来，朝俄双方一直保持着更紧密的关系。赵显呼吁二十国集团成员支持首尔为促进和平共处、缓和朝鲜半岛紧张局势而作出的努力。他还强调，需要国际合作确保霍尔木兹海峡的航行自由，并补充说，首尔将继续为保障这一战略水道的安全通行作出实质性贡献

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/20.body: Unionized workers at South Korean steelmaker POSCO will vote this week on a tentative wage agreement reached with management, the union said Sunday. The two sides have held 30 rounds of negotiations since June, while the union staged two partial strikes in September to demand higher wages and bonuses. Last week, the union said it would launch an "indefinite" strike from Nov. 2 unless the company presented an acceptable wage offer. On Friday, the union reached a tentative agreement on the company's latest offer, which includes a 2.6 percent increase in base pay, a one-off payment of 6 million won ($4,500) and improved benefits. Union members are scheduled to vote on the deal on Saturday. The union had initially demanded a 7.1 percent increase in base pay, a performance bonus equivalent to 600 percent of base pay, 50 company shares per worker and a holiday bonus equivalent to 200 percent of base pay. In addition to higher wages, the union cited staffing shortages and aging facilities as factors that could heighten the risk of workplace accidents. Management's previous offer included a 2.5 percent increase in base pay and a one-off payment of 5 million won

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body: North Korea has tested a cluster bomb that can be mounted on tactical ballistic missiles and vowed to field various types of cluster warheads by the end of the year, its state media said Sunday. The North's Missile Administration conducted the test on Saturday to assess adaptation to combat and power of a cluster-bomb warhead to be mounted on tactical ballistic missiles, the Korean Central News Agency (KCNA) said. Gen. Kim Jong-sik, member of the Central Military Commission of the ruling Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) and first vice department director of the WPK Central Committee oversaw the test, the KCNA said. A cluster bomb releases dozens to hundreds of submunitions, allowing it to strike multiple targets over a wide area. The research institutes under the Missile Administration "confirmed that Standard Type 2 cluster-bomb warhead is capable of turning into ashes a target area of 12 to 13 hectares with its highest-density power," according to the KCNA. The general director of the Missile Administration was quoted as stating that the cluster bomb warheads are classified into four categories depending on their purposes. "Within this year we will enable units to select and use all those types according to operational aims and specific features of targets," the director said. In April, North Korea said it tested cluster bombs mounted on the Hwasong-11 Ra tactical ballistic missile, a launch overseen by leader Kim Jong-un and his daughter Ju-ae. The North said the launch was to evaluate the power of the cluster bomb warhead and fragmentation mine warhead fitted to the weapon system

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/p.title: Women denied access to education mourn principal who gave it back
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/p.summary: Kim Sang-hyun, vice principal of Ilsung Women's Middle and High School, offered advice and encouragement to the students gathered in front of the platform on March 3 at Sinchon Methodist Church in western Seoul, at the school's entrance ceremony for the 2026 academic year. Among them was 77-year-old Lee Bok-gae, who was entering middle school that morning — an adult learner, one of the women who lost their chance at school due to financial difficulties and gender inequality in education.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/p.summary_zh: 3月3日，在位于首尔西部的新村卫理公会教堂举行2026学年入学典礼期间，伊尔松女子初中和高中副校长金相贤向聚集在站台前的学生提出建议并予以鼓励，其中包括当天开始就读初中的77岁李福恺。他是一名成人学习者，属于因经济困难和教育中的性别不平等而失去上学机会的女性之一。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/p.body: Kim Sang-hyun, vice principal of Ilsung Women's Middle and High School, offered advice and encouragement to the students gathered in front of the platform on March 3 at Sinchon Methodist Church in western Seoul, at the school's entrance ceremony for the 2026 academic year. The women about to become middle and high school students did not dress or look like other students. They wore hanbok, traditional Korean clothing, instead of uniforms, and not one of them looked like typical teenagers worn down by a nagging parent. Among them was 77-year-old Lee Bok-gae, who was entering middle school that morning — an adult learner, one of the women who lost their chance at school due to financial difficulties and gender inequality in education. Born the eldest of seven children, studying became an elusive dream, as she had to work while caring for her younger siblings. That same day, her granddaughter became a middle school student, too. On her way to a different school, the girl waved and called out to her, saying, "Grandmother, you're really cool. We're both middle school students now, so let's study hard together." "If this school didn't exist, I would have gone my whole life without ever easing the pain of being denied an education," Lee said. "I'm so grateful that even now I can run toward my dream. Teacher Lee Seon-jae, thank you so much." The vice principal ran most of the ceremony. The rest of the responsibilities rested on Lee Seon-jae, the principal to whom Lee Bok-gae had bowed her head. He had given his whole life to women living on the margins of the education system, and people called him the "Korean Pestalozzi," after Johann Heinrich Pestalozzi, the Swiss reformer who built schools for destitute children. On May 10, two months after that ceremony, he died. He was 90. Lee Seon-jae was born in Kaesong in 1936 and fled to Seoul during the 1951 evacuation of Seoul during the 1950-53 Korean War. Neighbors helped him through university, and in 1960, he opened a night school. Around that time, he heard that Ilsung Higher Civic School, which the children of war refugees attended, had gone a year without paying its rent and was holding classes outdoors. He went to a Korean medicine doctor he knew, someone who had already helped his night school, and asked for help. The school was not shut down. That was where his life with Ilsung began. Ten years passed. Older housewives and women factory workers began coming and going at Ilsung, a school until then attended mainly by refugees. The factory workers said they had come because reading the labels attached to clothing had made them curious about English. Their factory owners would not allow it. Pressed to choose — school or factory, one or the other — some of them stopped coming. What Lee Seon-jae built in answer was Ilsung's Sunday school, which threw its doors open on the one day the women did not report to the factory. The lives of the women he took in followed a similar path. Money was short. In the order of who got to study, they lost out to older and younger brothers, and were sent to work in the fields and the factories instead. As adults, they married into their husbands' families, and once they gave birth, child-rearing left them no time for themselves. When they had finally sent their children to university, they took up the care of aging parents and parents-in-law. That was what duty meant then. The school where the older women were welcomed was Ilsung Women's Middle and High School. It still enrolls 950 adult learners. They keep studying alongside the work that pays them — selling insurance, servicing water purifiers, cleaning buildings, working as certified care workers, keeping other people's houses. Kim Bong-ja, 67, was one of them. She graduated from the high school division of Ilsung and is now a student at Sookmyung Women's University. The day she received her diploma, she went to her parents' graves and wept. "Studying was my lifelong goal, and now every day feels like a dream," she said She thinks often about Lee Seon-jae's soybean-sprout lesson. "Teacher Lee used to encourage us by saying, 'When you study, there are plenty of times you forget things, but if you keep learning and learning, a moment comes when you shoot up all at once, like soybean sprouts in a sprouting pot,'" she said. "The teacher has gone on ahead of us, but his teaching will stay with me for the rest of my life." The students he opened the doors to were fiercely dedicated. Factory workers and housewives arrived so long before dawn that the school had to post a notice reading, "We open the doors at 7:30 a.m." Their zeal was a large part of why the school won recognition as an educational facility from the Seoul Metropolitan Office of Education in 2000 and grew into the Ilsung Women's Middle and High School of today. Some 63,000 students have reached the dream of learning in his care. Some of them came out of it with different lives altogether. Kang Hee-cheon, 68, is the clearest case. Kang spent middle school years in 1973 at Ilsung Higher Civic School, the predecessor of Ilsung Women's Middle and High School, where Lee taught abacus arithmetic. As Kang remembers him, Lee was always strict. Lee had recruited every child in Kang's class personally. He sought out children who were poor or abandoned by their parents — children of the street — talked them into it and brought them to the school himself. Lee drilled three things into his students: truthfulness, diligence and frugality. Only someone who does not deceive themselves can avoid deceiving others, he always added. Only someone who works sincerely can fulfill their use. Only someone who lives frugally can know what is precious. "Living right matters more than being smart" was his standing line, and whenever he spotted a student harboring resentment toward society and heading in a bad direction, Kang said, he went straight to the student's home and set it right. Kang remembers him as a teacher in the old sense of the word. "Teacher Lee Seon-jae was a mentor who lived out ahead of me, so I could learn how to live and follow even a little way behind him," Kang said. "He taught strictly, but he was the kind of person who would invent prizes that didn't exist just to spur his students on." "Maybe he is the person who decided the course of my life," Kang said. Kang finished Ilsung Higher Civic School under Lee, then entered university through a school-equivalency examination. Kang went on to pass the Grade 9 civil service examination, the entry-level rank, worked at the Mapo District Office and retired in 2017 as director of its safety and public administration bureau, a senior grade 4 post. Since retiring, Kang has volunteered with free meal programs for elderly people. "I chose the civil service because I wanted to be of benefit to society, the way Teacher Lee was," Kang said. "I wanted to give back what he gave me." The place Lee held open for adult learners may now disappear. In his will, he directed that the school operate only until February 2028. The Lifelong Education Act recognizes only school corporations and incorporated foundations as bodies entitled to establish a lifelong education facility, which means that once the founder steps away, the governing body has to convert into a converted entity. Conversion requires meeting a list of conditions, among them facilities and financing. In June, the school posted a petition on the National Assembly's website, asking lawmakers to amend the Lifelong Education Act to preserve the school's public service role, protect its students' right to learn and its teaching staff. The petition needed 50,000 signatures within a 30-day window. It did not get them, and it lapsed. Teachers and others at the school have asked education authorities for a public model instead — entrusting operations to a public foundation, for one — but the practical obstacles are considerable. Keeping open the school Lee had protected since 1960, a place that opened learning to women who had weathered life's hardships until they put their studies aside, now falls to the people he left behind. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/p.title_zh: 女性因无法获得教育而哀悼曾帮助她们重返校园的校长
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/p.body_zh: 3月3日，首尔西部新教堂_METHODIST Church举行2026学年度入学仪式，聚集在讲台前的伊颂女子初中和高中副校长金相贤向学生们提出建议并给予鼓励。这些即将成为初中生和高中生的女性，既没有穿着打扮成其他学生的样子，也没有任何人看起来像被唠叨的父母磨去锐气的普通青少年。其中有77岁的李福介，当天上午她将升入初中——她是一名成年学习者，也是那些因经济困难和教育领域的性别不平等而失去求学机会的女性之一。她是七个孩子中最大的一个，出生后不得不一边工作、一边照顾弟妹，学习便成了一个难以实现的梦想。同一天，她的孙女也成了一名初中生。女孩在前往另一所学校的路上向祖母挥手并喊道：“祖母，你真酷。现在我们都是初中生了，一起努力学习吧。”“要不是有这所学校，我可能一辈子都无法缓解被剥夺教育所带来的痛苦。”李说，“能有如今这个机会奔向自己的梦想，我感激不尽。李善宰老师，非常感谢你。”副校长主持了入学仪式的大部分活动，其余事务则由校长李善宰负责，李福介曾向他低头致意。他把一生都献给了生活在教育体系边缘的女性，人们称他为“韩国的裴斯泰洛齐”，以纪念那位为贫困儿童创办学校的瑞士教育家约翰·海因里希·裴斯泰洛齐。5月10日，也就是仪式举行两个月后，他去世了，享年90岁。李善宰1936年出生于开城，朝鲜战争期间，1950年至1953年，在1951年首尔大疏散中逃到首尔。邻居们帮助他读完大学，1960年，他创办了一所夜校。大约在那时，他听说战时难民子女就读的伊颂高等公民学校已经拖欠了一年房租，正在室外上课。他去找了一位相识的韩医，此人此前已经帮助过他的夜校，并向对方求助。学校没有关闭。这正是他与伊颂相伴的人生起点。十年过去了。年长的家庭主妇和女工开始来到伊颂；在那之前，这所学校主要由难民子女就读。女工们说，她们来这里是因为看到衣服上缝的标签后，便对英语产生了好奇。厂主不允许她们上课。在必须做出选择——上学还是进厂，二者只能选其一——的情况下，有些人不再来了。李善宰为此创办了伊颂星期学校，在女工们不用去工厂上班的那一天敞开大门。他接纳的女性的人生经历也大同小异。她们手头拮据。按照谁有资格学习的顺序，她们总会输给哥哥和弟弟，随后便被送去田里劳动或进厂工作。成年后，她们嫁入丈夫的家族，一旦生育孩子，育儿便不给她们留下任何属于自己的时间。等她们终于把孩子送进大学，又要承担照顾年迈父母和公婆的责任。那时的责任就是如此。年长女性能够进入的学校，正是伊颂女子初中和高中。如今，学校仍招收950名成年学习者，她们一边工作维持生计——销售保险、维修净水器、清洁楼宇、担任持证护理员、打理他人房屋——一边坚持学习。67岁的金芳娥就是其中之一。她从伊颂高中部毕业，如今是淑明女子大学的学生。拿到毕业证书那天，她前往父母墓前哭泣。“学习是我毕生的目标，如今每一天都像做梦一样。”她说。她经常想起李善宰老师关于豆芽的课。“李老师过去常鼓励我们说：‘学习时，有很多时候你会忘记学过的东西，但只要不断学习、不断学习，总有一个瞬间，你会像发豆盆里的豆芽一样一下子长起来。’”她说，“老师先我们一步离去了，但他的教诲会伴随我一生。”那些被他敞开大门接纳的学生，学习起来极其专注。女工和家庭主妇往往天还没亮就到了，学校不得不张贴告示：“本于早上7:30开门。”她们的热忱是学校于2000年获得首尔 Metropolitan Office of Education授予教育机构认可，并发展成为今天的伊颂女子初中和高中的重要原因。在他的关怀下，约63,000名学生实现了学习的梦想，其中一些人最终过上了截然不同的人生。68岁的姜熙真是最明显的例子。1973年，姜在伊颂高等公民学校读初中；这所学校是伊颂女子初中和高中的前身，当时李善宰在那里教授珠算。姜回忆说，李总是很严格。李会亲自招收班上的每一个孩子。他四处寻找贫困儿童、被父母遗弃的孩子——街头儿童——说服他们上学，再亲自把他们带到学校。李反复向学生强调三点：诚实、勤奋和节俭。他总说，只有不欺骗自己的人，才不会欺骗别人；只有真诚工作的人，才能发挥自己的作用；只有生活节俭的人，才懂得什么是珍贵。“走正道比聪明更重要”是他常说的一句话。每当姜发现某个学生心怀对社会的不满，正走向歧途时，李都会直接去那名学生家中，纠正其方向。姜始终以传统意义上的老师来回忆他。“李善宰老师是一位走在前面、让我能够学习如何生活并至少跟随他一小步的人生导师。”姜说，“他教得很严格，但也是那种会为了激励学生而凭空想出奖品的人。”“或许正是他决定了我人生的轨迹。”姜说。姜在李善宰的教导下从伊颂高等公民学校毕业，随后通过同等学历考试进入大学。她参加并通过了9级公务员考试，即入门级职位考试，曾在麻浦区公所任职，并于2017年以安全与行政管理局长的高级4级职位退休。退休后，姜一直在老年人免费供餐项目中担任志愿者。“我选择成为公务员，是因为我希望像李老师那样为社会作出贡献。”姜说，“我想回报他给予我的一切。”李善宰为成年学习者敞开的大门，如今或许将消失。他在遗嘱中指示，学校只运营到2028年2月。《终身教育法》仅承认学校法人和公益财团法人为有权设立终身教育机构的团体，这意味着创办者一旦离世，运营主体就必须转换为另一种法人实体。转换需要满足一系列条件，其中包括设施和资金。6月，学校在国民议会网站上发布请愿书，要求议员修改《终身教育法》，以保留学校的公共服务职能，保护学生的学习权和教职员工权益。请愿需要在30天内获得50,000个签名，但最终未能达成，因此失效。学校教师和其他人士已请求教育主管部门提供一种公办模式，例如把学校运营委托给公共基金会，但实际障碍相当多。让李自1960年起一直守护的学校继续开放，让它继续为那些经历人生艰辛、直到晚年才不得不放下学习的女性提供求学机会，如今落到了他留下的人们肩上。本文来自《韩国先驱报》，它是《韩国时报》的姊妹报，由生成式人工智能系统翻译，并由《韩国时报》编辑。

https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/01/a.body: The Presidential Campaign Council of the African Democratic Congress (ADC-PCC) has condemned the attack on its Sokoto State governorship candidate, Alhaji Munir Dan Iya, allegedly by the operatives of the state-owned security outfit known as the Sokoto Marshals. The attack reportedly occurred yesterday along Airport Road, Sokoto, as Dan Iya was returning to the city after accompanying former Governor of Sokoto State and Senator representing Sokoto South, Senator Aminu Waziri Tambuwal, from the airport. Several vehicles in the governorship candidate’s convoy were allegedly vandalised and extensively damaged by the armed operatives. The ADC-PCC spokesman further said that ”In an even more alarming development, two Department of State Services (DSS) personnel attached to the ADC governorship candidate were reportedly abducted by the Sokoto Marshals”. He said Dan Iya formally reported the incident to the Sokoto State Commissioner of Police, adding that his personal SUV was also vandalised during the attack. The spokesman of the ADC campaign added that ”this reprehensible conduct is provocative, unacceptable and represents a dangerous descent into state-sponsored thuggery. “It is part of a disturbing pattern of political intimidation and violence against ADC members and opposition figures across the country. ”Only a few weeks ago, similar incidents were reported in Kaduna and other states. Sokoto has now become the latest theatre of this growing assault on democratic freedom. Ologbondiyan said, ”We are particularly alarmed that a security outfit established and funded with taxpayers’ money is allegedly being transformed into a political militia for intimidating, harassing and attacking perceived political opponents. ”This is not governance. It is banditry in uniform, and it must not be tolerated in a democracy. ”Let it be clearly understood that the ADC will no longer sit back and watch its members, leaders and candidates being subjected to intimidation and violence anywhere in Nigeria. The era of taking our party for granted, threatening its members and attacking its political structures with impunity is over. ”This must be the last time such an attack is allowed to happen., Abdullahi stated. Accordingly, the spokesman of the ADC PCC said, ”While the ADC remains committed to peaceful political engagement and the rule of law, we are fully prepared to defend our members and protect their constitutional rights through every legitimate means available to us. ”No individual or group has a monopoly of violence, intimidation or lawlessness.” The ADC PCC called on the Inspector-General of Police, the Sokoto State Commissioner of Police and all relevant security and intelligence agencies to immediately investigate these incidents, apprehend those responsible, secure the release of the two DSS personnel reportedly abducted and ensure that all perpetrators are brought to justice. ”We hereby give the relevant authorities 24 hours to rein in these rogue elements, secure the safety of our candidate and members, and commence decisive action to bring the perpetrators to justice. ”Failure to do so will leave the leadership of our party with no option but to take further decisive and lawful steps to protect its members, defend its political rights and safeguard our democracy. Nigeria cannot afford to descend into an era where state-funded security outfits are deployed as instruments of political persecution,” Ologbondiyan stated. https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/01/a.body_zh: 非洲民主大会（ADC）总统竞选委员会（ADC-PCC）谴责了对其索科托州州长候选人阿尔哈吉·穆尼尔·丹·伊亚的袭击，据称袭击者是该州所属安全机构索科托骑卫队的行动人员。据报道，袭击于昨日发生在索科托机场路，当时丹·伊亚护送索科托州前州长、索科托南选区联邦参议员阿米努·瓦齐里·坦布瓦尔从机场返回市区。州长候选人车队中的数辆车辆据称遭到武装行动人员破坏，并严重受损。ADC-PCC发言人进一步表示：“更令人警惕的是，两名派驻ADC州长候选人身边的国家安全局（DSS）人员据称遭索科托骑卫队绑架。”他说，丹·伊亚已正式向索科托州警察局长报告此事，并补充称，袭击期间他的个人SUV也遭到破坏。ADC竞选委员会发言人还表示：“这种应受谴责的行为具有挑衅性，不可接受，也标志着国家支持的暴徒行为正危险地滑坡。这是全国针对ADC成员和反对派人士实施政治恐吓与暴力的令人不安模式中的一环。就在几周前，卡杜纳州和其他一些州也报告了类似事件。索科托州如今已成为这种不断加剧的对民主自由侵犯的最新现场。我们尤其感到警惕的是，一个由纳税人资金设立并供养的安保机构，据称正被改造成政治民兵，用来恐吓、骚扰和袭击被认定的政治对手。这不是治理，而是穿着制服的匪徒行为，在民主国家中绝不能容忍。必须明确理解，ADC绝不会再袖手旁观，任由其成员、领导人和候选人在尼日利亚任何地方遭受恐吓和暴力。以为可以任意欺凌我们的党、威胁其成员并肆无忌惮地袭击其政治结构的时代已经结束。此类袭击绝不能再被允许发生。”阿卜杜拉希表示。因此，ADC竞选委员会发言人说：“尽管ADC仍致力于通过和平方式参与政治并维护法治，但我们已做好充分准备，将通过一切合法手段保护我们的成员并捍卫其宪法权利。任何个人或团体都不垄断暴力、恐吓或违法行为的权力。”ADC竞选委员会呼吁警察总监、索科托州警察局长以及所有相关安全和情报机构立即调查这些事件，逮捕责任人，确保获释两名据称遭绑架的DSS人员，并确保所有犯罪者受到司法制裁。“我们在此责成相关当局在24小时内制止这些不法分子，确保我们的候选人和成员安全，并开始采取果断行动，将犯罪者绳之以法。否则，我们党的领导层将别无选择，只能采取进一步果断且合法的措施，保护我们的成员，捍卫我们的政治权利并维护我们的民主。尼日利亚不能滑向由国家供养的安保机构被部署为政治迫害工具的时代。”奥洛格博迪扬表示。THISDAY于1995年1月22日创办，由THISDAY NEWSPAPERS LTD.出版，地址为尼日利亚拉各斯阿帕帕克里克路35号，在尼日利亚36个州、联邦首都辖区以及世界各地设有办事处。它是尼日利亚最权威的新闻媒体，通过所有平台服务政治、商业、专业和外交精英以及更广泛的中产阶层，同时为有抱负者和千禧一代提供连接新思想、文化与技术的交汇点。该报秉持公共信托精神，专门追求真相与理性，报道范围涵盖突发新闻、政治、商业、市场、艺术、体育、社区，以及人与社会的交汇点。您可以发送电子邮件至：hello@thisdaylive.com，或访问我们的联系我们页面

https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/01/n.summary: •Threaten removal of illegal structures on transmission routes The House of Representatives’ Committee on Public Assets has threatened to demolish illegal structures erected on the federal government’s rights of way (ROW) for power transmission projects, warning that encroachment and vandalism were threatening investments in the electricity sector.
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/01/n.summary_zh: •威胁拆除输电线路上的违法建筑。众议院公共资产委员会威胁拆除联邦政府为输电项目预留的通行权（ROW）范围内搭建的违法建筑，并警告称，侵占和故意破坏正威胁电力行业 investments。
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/01/n.body: •Threaten removal of illegal structures on transmission routes The House of Representatives’ Committee on Public Assets has threatened to demolish illegal structures erected on the federal government’s rights of way (ROW) for power transmission projects, warning that encroachment and vandalism were threatening investments in the electricity sector. The Chairman of the committee, Kuye Ademorin, gave the warning during inspection of the 132kV New Haven-Ninth Mile-Nsukka Double Circuit Transmission Line in Enugu State and the Egbu 330/132/33kV substation in Owerri, Imo State. The committee expressed concern that churches, hotels, private residences and even state government buildings had been erected along designated transmission routes, potentially delaying the completion of projects designed to improve electricity supply. Other lawmakers on the inspection tour, according to a statement by the NDPHC spokesperson, Nazo Agim, included Mark Obetta, Lanre Okunlola, Sani Rigo and Canice Nwachukwu. Ademorin questioned how state authorities could approve developments along corridors already designated as federal government rights of way, describing the situation as a threat to critical national infrastructure. He said the committee was impressed by the scale of the federal government’s investment in developing a sustainable electricity system but was disappointed that some communities were undermining the initiative through encroachment and vandalism. “We observed the magnitude of investment by the federal government in building a sustainable power system for the country, particularly in our states, to help them develop their industrial base through adequate power supply. “However, to our chagrin and disappointment, we saw a people who are not totally buying into the vision of a greater country for all of us,” he said. The lawmaker warned that the National Assembly would take appropriate measures to ensure that illegal structures were removed from the affected corridors. “It is not going to be business as usual. We are going to take drastic, appropriate steps to ensure that those structures are removed,” he said. The committee also called for stronger collaboration between federal and state governments to protect public assets and prevent further delays to electricity infrastructure projects. At the Egbu substation, the delegation acknowledged that the facility was about 85 per cent complete and, upon completion, would add approximately 250 megawatts to electricity supply in Imo State, significantly improving power delivery to the Orlu area. The project, which was first awarded in 2006, has received renewed attention under the leadership of NDPHC Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer, Jennifer Adighije. Ademorin commended the quality of work at the substation and expressed optimism that its anticipated completion around March 2027 would stimulate industrial activities across the South-east. He, however, urged the federal government to ensure the timely completion of ongoing projects and prompt payment of contractors to avoid unnecessary delays. The committee chairman also emphasised the need for adequate and timely compensation for landowners whose properties were acquired for public infrastructure, noting that unresolved compensation issues could trigger disputes and litigation. He appealed to the governors of Enugu and Imo states to work with NDPHC to address encroachment, protect federal assets and accelerate the delivery of the projects. Ademorin further advised Nigerians to verify the ownership and status of land before purchasing properties, particularly around designated government rights of way, to avoid acquiring plots earmarked for public infrastructure. https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/01/n.body_zh: •威胁拆除输电线路沿线非法建筑 众议院公共资产委员会威胁拆除联邦政府输电项目用地范围内非法搭建的设施，并警告称，侵占和破坏行为正在威胁电力行业的投资。委员会主席Kuye Ademorin在检查恩古州132kV New Haven—Ninth Mile—Nsukka双回输电线路以及伊莫州奥韦里Egbu 330/132/33kV变电站时发出警告。委员会表示关切，称指定输电线路沿线已建有教堂、酒店、私人住宅，甚至州政府大楼，可能延误旨在改善电力供应的项目竣工。根据尼日利亚联邦电力控股公司发言人Nazo Agim发表的声明，参加此次检查的其他议员包括Mark Obetta、Lanre Okunlola、Sani Rigo和Canice Nwachukwu。Ademorin质疑州 authorities 如何能够批准在已被划定为联邦政府用地范围的走廊沿线开展开发，并称这一局面威胁到关键国家基础设施。他说，委员会对联邦政府为建设可持续电力体系所投入的大量资金印象深刻，但对一些社区通过侵占和破坏破坏该举措感到失望。他说：“我们看到联邦政府为建设可持续电力体系所投入的大量资金，特别是对我们所在各州的投资，旨在通过充足供电帮助它们发展工业基础。“然而，令我们懊恼和失望的是，我们看到一些民众并不完全认同建设一个属于所有人的更伟大国家这一愿景。”这名议员警告称，国民议会将采取适当措施，确保拆除受影响走廊内的非法建筑。他说：“一切照旧的日子不会继续。我们将采取严厉而适当的措施，确保拆除这些建筑。”委员会还呼吁联邦政府和州政府加强协作，保护公共资产，防止电力基础设施项目进一步延误。在Egbu变电站，代表团承认该设施已完成约85%，竣工后预计将向伊莫州新增约250兆瓦电力供应，显著改善奥鲁地区的供电。该项目于2006年首次中标，在尼日利亚联邦电力控股公司董事兼首席执行官Jennifer Adighije的领导下重新受到关注。Ademorin赞扬了变电站的工程质量，并乐观地表示，其预计于2027年3月左右竣工，将推动尼日利亚东南部各地工业活动。然而，他敦促联邦政府确保在建项目按时完工，并及时向承包商付款，以避免不必要的延误。委员会主席还强调，应向土地被征收用于公共基础设施的业主提供充分、及时的补偿，并指出，补偿问题未得到解决可能引发争端和诉讼。他呼吁恩古州和伊莫州州长与尼日利亚联邦电力控股公司合作，处理侵占问题、保护联邦资产并加快项目交付。Ademorin还建议尼日利亚人在购买房产前核实土地所有权和状态，尤其是在指定的政府用地范围周边，以避免购入 earmarked 用于公共基础设施的地块。THISDAY于1995年1月22日创办，由THISDAY NEWSPAPERS LTD.出版，地址为尼日利亚拉各斯阿帕帕Creek Road 35号，在尼日利亚36个州、联邦首都辖区以及世界各地设有办公室。它是尼日利亚最具权威性的新闻媒体，通过所有平台面向政治、商业、专业和外交精英以及更广泛的中产阶级，同时为有志者和千禧一代提供新思想、文化与技术的交汇点。该报秉持公共信托精神，追求真相与理性，报道范围涵盖突发新闻、政治、商业、金融市场、艺术、体育、社区，以及人与社会的交汇点。您可以发送邮件至：hello@thisdaylive.com，或访问我们的联系我们页面

https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/01/d.title: Daura: Makinde is the Most Competent, Credible Presidential Candidate for 2027 Election
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/01/d.summary: The vice-presidential candidate of the Allied Peoples Movement (APM), Alhaji Lawal Daura, has described the party’s presidential candidate and Oyo State Governor, Seyi Makinde, as the most competent and credible of all the presidential candidates in the 2027 general election, given his unmatched performance as governor of Oyo State.
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/01/d.summary_zh: 人民联盟运动（APM）副总统候选人阿尔哈吉·洛瓦尔·道拉称，该党总统候选人、奥约州州长塞伊·马金德是2027年大选所有总统候选人中最有能力、最可信的一位，因为他担任奥约州州长期间取得了无与伦比的成绩。
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/01/d.body: The vice-presidential candidate of the Allied Peoples Movement (APM), Alhaji Lawal Daura, has described the party’s presidential candidate and Oyo State Governor, Seyi Makinde, as the most competent and credible of all the presidential candidates in the 2027 general election, given his unmatched performance as governor of Oyo State. This comes as the APM vice-presidential candidate reassured the nation, particularly the northern region, that the Makinde/Daura administration will be a four-year, all-inclusive, transitional government of national unity focused on Resetting Nigeria’s economy, education, security architecture, and socio-political space. The APM vice presidential candidate particularly thanked the region for its commitment towards the campaign, stressing that Makinde ranks above other presidential candidates on performance, national vision, productivity and service delivery. He urged Nigerians to eschew ethnic sentiments and focus on candidates’ antecedents and public service records, stressing that anyone seeking to lead the country must be prepared to account for their stewardship and contributions to national development. Daura stated, “I was happy when you said that you went to Oyo State, and you have confirmed the quality of governance and unprecedented development by our Presidential candidate. So, I challenge anyone who still doubts whether our candidate is the most competent to be elected President to examine his antecedents and performance. “Before venturing into politics and eventually becoming governor of Oyo State, he had established himself as a successful businessman and a man with considerable experience in finance. “Beyond his personal integrity, we should also examine his record in public office. What has he achieved? Look at his performance. His transparency and accountability set him apart. “We, in Nigeria, are confronted with enormous challenges, particularly poverty and poor governance. We cannot afford to continue supporting leadership without examining what individuals have done with the opportunities entrusted to them.” Daura stressed that anyone aspiring to lead Nigeria must be ready to account for their achievements, management of public resources and contributions to the development of the people, noting that leaders who openly demonstrate accountability in public office deserve serious consideration. He also commended the Northern Patriotic Front for advocating people-centred democracy, urging political parties, politicians and other stakeholders to promote public enlightenment to enable Nigerians to make informed choices at the polls. Daura described Makinde’s administration as transitional, saying its four-year term would lay the foundation for sustainable governance and address the country’s underlying challenges. Speaking earlier at the meeting, President of the NPF, Alhaji Ali Abacha pledged the support of political stakeholders in the north, adding that the region was at home with Makinde’s candidacy, his Reset Nigeria message and his commitment to a four-year transitional government. He said Makinde’s sterling performance in Oyo State had distinguished him as the most competent presidential candidate, which informed the decision of stakeholders in the north to support his Reset Nigeria agenda. Abacha also commended Makinde for choosing Daura, a security expert, as his running mate, adding that such a choice reassures the nation of a commitment to tackle insecurity in the country. https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/01/d.title_zh: 达拉：马金德是2027年总统选举中最有能力、最可信的候选人
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/01/d.body_zh: 人民联盟运动（APM）副总统候选人Alhaji Lawal Daura表示，该党总统候选人、奥约州州长Seyi Makinde凭借担任奥约州州长期间无人能及的表现，是2027年大选所有总统候选人中最有能力、最值得信赖的人选。APM副总统候选人同时向全国，尤其是北部地区保证，Makinde/Daura政府将建立一个为期四年、兼顾各方、致力于推动全国团结的过渡政府，重点重置尼日利亚的经济、教育、安全架构和社会政治空间。APM副总统候选人特别感谢该地区对竞选活动的投入，强调无论在政绩、国家愿景、生产力和公共服务方面，Makinde都名列其他总统候选人之上。他敦促尼日利亚人摒弃族群情绪，关注候选人的过往经历和公共服务记录，强调任何寻求领导国家的人都必须准备说明自己的治理表现及其对国家发展的贡献。Daura表示：“你们说去过奥约州时，我感到很高兴，因为你们证实了我们的总统候选人的治理质量和前所未有的发展。因此，我要求任何仍然怀疑我们的候选人是否最有能力当选总统的人，都去审视他的过往经历和表现。“在踏入政坛并最终成为奥约州州长之前，他已经证明自己是一名成功的商人，并拥有丰富的金融经验。“除了个人的操守之外，我们还应该审视他在公职上的记录。他取得了什么成就？看看他的表现。他的透明度和问责制使他脱颖而出。“在尼日利亚，我们面临巨大的挑战，尤其是贫困和治理不善。我们不能继续支持那些不去审视个人如何使用所获机会的领导层。”Daura强调，任何有志领导尼日利亚的人都必须准备说明自己的成就、公共资源管理情况以及为民众发展作出的贡献，并指出，那些在公职上公开表现出问责精神的领导人值得认真考虑。他还赞扬北方爱国阵线倡导以人民为中心的民主，敦促政党、政治人物及其他利益相关方加强公众启蒙，使尼日利亚人能够在投票时作出明智选择。Daura将Makinde政府描述为过渡性政府，称其四年任期将为可持续治理奠定基础，并解决国家面临的根本性挑战。此前在会议上，北方爱国阵线主席Alhaji Ali Abacha承诺获得北方政治利益相关方的支持，并补充说，该地区对Makinde参选、他的“重置尼日利亚”理念以及他推行四年过渡政府的承诺感到放心。他说，Makinde在奥约州出色的表现使他成为最有能力的总统候选人，这也促使北方利益相关方决定支持他的“重置尼日利亚”议程。Abacha还赞扬Makinde选择安全专家Daura作为竞选搭档，称这一选择让全国相信，政府决心处理国家安全问题。THISDAY于1995年1月22日创办，由THISDAY NEWSPAPERS LTD.出版，地址为尼日利亚拉各斯阿帕帕溪路35号，在尼日利亚36个州、联邦首都辖区及世界各地设有办公室。对于政治、商业、专业和外交精英以及更广泛的中产阶级而言，该报是可通过所有平台获取的尼日利亚最具权威性的新闻媒体，同时也是锐意进取者和千禧一代的新思想、文化与技术交汇点。该报是一项公共信托，致力于追求真理和理性，报道范围从突发新闻、政治、商业、金融市场、艺术、体育和社区生活延伸至个人与社会的交汇点。你可以发送邮件至：hello@thisdaylive.com，或访问我们的联系我们页面

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110102.body_zh: （首尔=韩联社）记者高东旭报道：韩国总统李在明1日得知韩国今年出口额历史上首次突破9000亿美元后表示，“我们庆祝出口突破1000亿美元的日子仿佛就在昨天，令人百感交集。”当天，他在X（旧称推特）上写下上述内容，并鼓励说：“感谢企业界人士和生产一线的劳动者们，大家辛苦了。”随后，他又说：“政府将通过务实的国家利益外交，推动大家为拓展经济疆域继续努力。”“韩国全体国民一起在全世界播下并培育‘K’吧。”据产业通商部消息，今年1月至10月累计出口额为9300亿美元，历史上首次突破9000亿美元。按照这一趋势，预计11月中旬全年出口额将突破1万亿美元。稿件可通过KakaoTalk的okjebo联系。版权所有(c) 韩联社，禁止擅自转载或再分发，禁止用于人工智能学习及利用。2026年11月1日11:33发布，2026年11月1日11时33分发稿。

https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/01/n.summary: As part of measures to ensure stronger customer service and tighter digital security, the Comptroller General of Nigeria Immigration Service (NIS), Kemi Nanna Nandap, has directed personnel to eliminate unnecessary delays in service delivery and to promptly report suspected cyber threats.
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/01/n.summary_zh: 作为加强客户服务和收紧数字安全措施的一部分，尼日利亚移民局总监察长凯米·南娜·南达普已指示工作人员消除服务办理中的无谓延误，并迅速报告疑似网络威胁。
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/01/n.body: As part of measures to ensure stronger customer service and tighter digital security, the Comptroller General of Nigeria Immigration Service (NIS), Kemi Nanna Nandap, has directed personnel to eliminate unnecessary delays in service delivery and to promptly report suspected cyber threats. The agency’s Public Relations Officer, DCI Akinsola Akinlabi, said in a statement yesterday that Nandap gave the charge at two separate events in Abuja – the 2026 International Customer Service Week and the Service’s 2026 Cybersecurity Awareness Seminar. Speaking at the closing of the Customer Service Week, which ran from Wednesday, October 28, to Friday, October 30, under the theme “Going the Extra Mile – Creating a Lasting Smile,” Nandap urged officers to make excellent customer service part of the Service’s daily operations. She stressed the need for professionalism, timely service delivery, prompt complaints resolutions and respectful treatment of customers. The Comptroller General charged officers to uphold integrity, eliminate unnecessary delays and make customer satisfaction a key performance benchmark. She also reaffirmed ongoing reforms to improve customer satisfaction and what the Service calls Hostmanship. In her speech, the Head of Operations at the Service Compact with all Nigerians (SERVICOM) unit in the Presidency, Mrs Ngozi Akinbodewa, commended NIS for evolving its SERVICOM Unit. She said this year’s Customer Service Week marked a critical step towards sustaining citizen-focused service delivery in line with global best practices. Akinbodewa added that the international event offered an opportunity to recognise employees who exceeded expectations and met customer needs. Also speaking, the Special Assistant to the Comptroller-General of Immigration Service on SERVICOM, DCI A.M. Abubakar, highlighted the importance of accountability, responsiveness and adherence to service standards. He urged officers to continually improve their conduct and prioritise customer satisfaction in the discharge of their duties. At the Cybersecurity Awareness Seminar, Nandap, who was represented by the Deputy Comptroller General, Finance and Accounts, DCG S.B. Daura, told officers that cybersecurity is a collective responsibility. She urged them to remain vigilant, observe established security protocols and promptly report suspected threats. She also called for continuous capacity building, institutional collaboration and proactive measures to address emerging cyber threats, before declaring the seminar open. Resource persons from the Department of State Services (DSS), the United Nations Office on Drugs and Crime (UNODC), the Nigeria Data Protection Commission (NDPC) and the National Information Technology Development Agency (NITDA) made technical presentations. They covered inter-agency collaboration for cybersecurity and critical infrastructure protection, combating cybercrime through law enforcement and international cooperation, data protection and privacy in the digital age, and human risk management in the digital workplace. A plenary session facilitated by Galaxy Backbone Limited (GBB) examined strategies for securing critical systems through inter-agency collaboration, giving participants a chance to exchange experiences and explore practical approaches to strengthening the Service’s cybersecurity framework. The Service said the seminar reaffirmed its commitment to building a cyber-resilient institution through continuous capacity development, technology upgrades, inter-agency collaboration and compliance with global best practices. https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/01/n.body_zh: 作为加强客户服务和强化数字安全措施的一部分，尼日利亚移民局（NIS）总监察长Kemi Nanna Nandap已指示工作人员消除服务过程中一切不必要的延误，并及时报告疑似网络威胁。该局公共关系官DCI Akinsola Akinlabi昨日发表声明称，Nandap分别在阿布贾举行的两场活动上作出上述要求，即2026年国际客户服务周和该局2026年网络安全意识研讨会。在10月28日星期三至10月30日星期五举行的客户服务周闭幕活动上，Nandap敦促工作人员将卓越的客户服务纳入该局的日常运作。她强调，工作人员必须保持专业精神、及时提供服务、及时解决投诉，并尊重和善待顾客。总监察长要求工作人员坚守诚信，消除不必要的延误，并将客户满意度作为关键绩效指标。她还重申将继续推进改革，以提升客户满意度以及该局所称的主人翁精神。在总统府“服务与所有尼日利亚人保持承诺”（SERVICOM）部门负责人在仪式上发言时，SERVICOM部门负责人Ngozi Akinbodewa女士赞扬了尼日利亚移民局推动其SERVICOM部门不断发展的举措。她说，今年的客户服务周是按照全球最佳做法持续提供以公民为中心服务的重要一步。Akinbodewa补充称，这项国际活动为表彰超越预期、满足客户需求的员工提供了机会。尼日利亚移民局总监察长负责SERVICOM事务的特别助理DCI A.M. Abubakar也在会上发言，强调问责制、响应能力以及遵守服务标准的重要性。他敦促工作人员不断改进履职表现，在履行职责时把客户满意度置于优先位置。在网络安全意识研讨会上，由财务与账目副总监察长DCG S.B. Daura代表Nandap出席的Nandap告诉工作人员，网络安全是所有人的共同责任。她敦促他们保持警惕，遵守既定安全规程，并及时报告可疑威胁。她还呼吁持续加强能力建设、机构间协作，并采取积极措施应对新出现的网络威胁，随后宣布研讨会开幕。来自国家情报部门（DSS）、联合国毒品和犯罪问题办公室（UNODC）、尼日利亚数据保护委员会（NDPC）和国家信息技术发展局（NITDA）的专家进行了专题报告，内容涵盖网络安全机构间协作与关键基础设施保护、通过执法和国际合作打击网络犯罪、数字时代的数据保护与隐私，以及数字工作场所中的人为风险管理。由Galaxy Backbone Limited（GBB）主持的全会讨论了通过机构间协作保障关键系统安全的策略，并让参与者有机会交流经验，探索加强该局网络安全框架的可行办法。该局表示，本次研讨会重申了通过持续提升能力、升级技术、加强机构间协作以及遵守全球最佳做法，建设具备网络韧性的机构的决心。THISDAY于1995年1月22日创办，由THISDAY NEWSPAPERS LTD.出版，地址为尼日利亚拉各斯阿帕帕溪路35号，在尼日利亚36个州、联邦首都辖区及世界各地设有办公室。作为尼日利亚最权威的新闻媒体，该报通过全平台面向政界、商业界、专业人士和外交精英以及更广泛的中产阶层传播信息，同时充当抱负者、千禧一代探索新思想、文化和技术的交汇点。该报秉持公众信任， dedicated to追求真理与理性，报道范围从突发新闻延伸至政治、商业、金融市场、艺术、体育和社区议题，覆盖个人与社会的交汇点。您可以发送邮件至hello@thisdaylive.com，或访问我们的联系我们页面

https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/01/a.body: Chuks Okocha in Abuja Former Vice President and the presidential candidate of the African Democratic Congress (ADC), Atiku Abubukar, has condemned the attacks on the presidential candidate of the African Action Congress (AAC), Omoyele Sowore, in Ekiti State by thugs and the governorship candidate of the ADC, Manir Muhammad Dan’iya in Sokoto State. According to the ADC presidential candidate, ”these twin assaults expose the extent to which the ruling APC administration is prepared to oppress and intimidate opposition leaders and their supporters. ”It is particularly disturbing that while President Bola Tinubu is away on spiritual pilgrimage, political enforcers and thugs loyal to his party are unleashing terror on his political opponents at home. These two realities cannot coexist in a democracy. He said that these incidents are unbecoming of any democratic government and starkly reveal the desperation of the President Bola Tinubu administration. According, the ADC presidential candidate said, ”We therefore demand immediate and transparent investigations into both attacks. The Tinubu government must refrain from any attempt to muzzle the opposition and must guarantee a free, fair, and competitive contest in the forthcoming general elections. ”I have it on good authority that a local security outfit in Sokoto State has been harassing ADC supporters, manhandling citizens simply for wearing ADC merchandise. ”We shall resist every ongoing attempt to cancel political opposition in Nigeria. The ruling APC has failed in its mandate. Nigerians must be allowed to freely participate in an electoral contest that will determine the fate of this administration,” the former vice president stated. https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/01/a.body_zh: 阿布贾：非洲民主大会党（ADC）前副总统、总统候选人阿提库·阿布杜卡指责称，暴力分子在Ekiti State袭击非洲行动大会党（AAC）总统候选人奥莫耶莱·索沃雷，并在Sokoto State袭击ADC州长候选人曼尼尔·穆罕默德·丹亚。他说：“这两起袭击暴露了执政的APC政府为压制和恐吓反对派领导人及其支持者而不惜采取何等手段。尤其令人不安的是，总统博拉·蒂努布外出进行宗教朝圣之际，其政党忠实于他的政治施压者和暴徒却在国内向其政治对手释放恐怖。这两种现实在民主制度中不可能并存。”他说，这些事件有悖于任何民主政府的应有行为，也鲜明揭示了博拉·蒂努布政府的绝望。ADC总统候选人表示：“因此，我们要求立即对两起袭击展开透明调查。蒂努布政府必须避免任何压制反对派的做法，并必须保证即将举行的选举能够自由、公平和公正地展开。”他还说：“我得到可靠消息，Sokoto State的一个地方安全组织一直骚扰ADC支持者，仅仅因为公民穿戴ADC宣传用品就对他们动手动脚。我们将抵制一切试图取消尼日利亚政治反对派的持续行为。执政的APC未能履行其使命。必须允许尼日利亚人自由参加决定本届政府命运的选举。”这位前副总统表示。THISDAY于1995年1月22日创办，由THISDAY NEWSPAPERS LTD.出版，地址为尼日利亚拉各斯阿帕帕克里克路35号，在尼日利亚36个州、联邦首都领地及世界各地设有办公室。作为尼日利亚最具权威性的新闻媒体，该报通过所有平台面向政治、商业、专业和外交精英以及更广泛的中产阶层报道，同时充当抱负人士和千禧一代探索新思想、文化与技术的交汇点。该报秉持公共信托精神，致力于追求真相与理性，报道范围涵盖突发新闻、政治、商业、金融市场、艺术、体育和社区，以及人與社会关系的交汇点。您可以给我们发送电子邮件至：hello@thisdaylive.com，或访问我们的联系我们页面

https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/01/h.summary: The Joint Health Sector Unions (JOHESU) have begun mobilising health workers nationwide for possible industrial action over the federal government’s failure to implement the Consolidated Health Salary Structure (CONHESS) adjustment. https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/01/h.summary_zh: 联合卫生部门工会（JOHESU）已开始在全國動員醫護人員，可能因聯邦政府未能落實《綜合醫務人員薪資結構》（CONHESS）調整而發動 industrial action。該工會此前警告，將抵制任何企圖阻礙薪資調整的行為，並表示已不再準備容忍進一步延遲落實協議。
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/01/h.body: The Joint Health Sector Unions (JOHESU) have begun mobilising health workers nationwide for possible industrial action over the federal government’s failure to implement the Consolidated Health Salary Structure (CONHESS) adjustment. This demand has remained unresolved for about 13 years. The union, which warned that it would resist any attempt to frustrate the salary adjustment, said it was no longer prepared to tolerate further delays in implementing the agreement. This was part of the resolutions reached at an emergency expanded National Executive Council (NEC) virtual meeting held on Thursday, October 29, 2026, attended by its affiliates and organs at federal and state levels. The union recalled that President Bola Tinubu had, on June 5, 2023, promised to actualise the adjustment while appealing to JOHESU to suspend its strike after assuming office. It also recalled that the Federal Ministry of Health and Social Welfare had, on the same date, forwarded the 2021 High Level Body Technical Committee Report on the adjustment to the Budget Office of the Federation, the secretariat of the Presidential Committee on Salaries (PCS). However, JOHESU accused the government of allowing the process to stall because the PCS could not meet, warning that any further attempt to use the committee’s failure to act as an excuse would meet resistance. The union commended the Nigeria Labour Congress (NLC) and the Trade Union Congress of Nigeria (TUC) for taking decisive steps to secure the adjustment, describing it as the oldest demand in organised labour history. It also reminded the federal government of the provisions of the Trade Unions Act, Cap T14, LFN, 2004, which permits trade unions to negotiate benefit packages and collective bargaining agreements on behalf of their members. JOHESU consequently placed its members on alert and directed the commencement of mobilisation across health institutions nationwide for a possible industrial action and what it described as necessary but unparalleled resistance should the government yield to attempts to frustrate the demand. The union, however, urged members to remain peaceful while awaiting further directives from the NLC and TUC, following the ultimatum and timeline issued to the federal government. https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/01/h.title_zh: 卫生工作者动员起来，准备与联邦政府就13年薪资调整延迟问题摊牌
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/01/h.body_zh: 联合卫生部门工会（JOHESU）已开始在全国范围内动员卫生工作者，可能因联邦政府未能落实《统一卫生工资结构》（CONHESS）调整而采取工业行动。这一诉求已悬而未决约13年。该工会曾警告，将抵制任何阻挠工资调整的企图，并表示已不再准备容忍协议落实继续拖延。这是工会于2026年10月29日星期四举行的全国执行委员会（NEC）紧急扩大虚拟会议所通过决议的一部分，其联邦和州级附属机构及组织派员出席了会议。工会回顾称，总统博拉·蒂努布曾于2023年6月5日承诺落实工资调整，同时在上任后敦促JOHESU暂停罢工。工会还指出，联邦卫生和社会福利部于同日向联邦预算办公室暨总统薪资委员会（PCS）秘书处转交了有关调整的2021年高层机构技术委员会报告。然而，JOHESU指责政府任由这一进程陷入停滞，因为PCS无法开会，并警告称，任何再次企图以委员会未采取行动作为拖延借口的做法都将遭到抵制。工会赞扬尼日利亚劳工大会（NLC）和尼日利亚工会大会（TUC）为促成工资调整采取果断措施，并称这是有组织劳工历史上持续时间最长的诉求。工会还提醒联邦政府遵守《2004年工会法》T14章《尼日利亚联邦法律汇编》的规定，该法允许工会代表成员谈判福利方案和集体谈判协议。因此，JOHESU已要求成员保持戒备，并指示在全国各医疗和卫生机构启动动员，为可能采取工业行动以及其所称必要但前所未有的抵制行动作准备，以防政府屈从于阻挠这一诉求的企图。不过，在等待NLC和TUC根据向联邦政府发出的最后通牒及时间表进一步下达指示期间，工会仍敦促成员保持和平。THISDAY于1995年1月22日创刊，由THISDAY NEWSPAPERS LTD.出版，地址为尼日利亚拉各斯阿帕帕克里克路35号，在尼日利亚36个州、联邦首都地区及世界各地设有办公室。作为尼日利亚最具权威性的新闻媒体，THISDAY通过所有平台服务政治、商业、专业和外交精英以及更广泛的中产阶级，同时为有志者、千禧一代提供新思想、文化和技术交汇的平台。该报秉持公共信托精神，致力于追求真相与理性，报道范围涵盖突发新闻、政治、商业、金融市场、艺术、体育和社区等议题，直至探索人与社会的交汇点。您可以发送邮件至：hello@thisdaylive.com，或访问我们的联系我们页面
